title: NullPointerException when accessing user profile in AuthService
description: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke 'com.example.User.getRoles()' because 'user' is null at com.example.service.AuthService.validateToken(AuthService.java:42). Occurs when expired JWT payload is decoded without DB fallback.
root_cause: Unchecked object dereference without verifying if the user repository found an active entity.
resolution: Add Optional<User> check and throw InvalidCredentialsException instead of allowing null propagation.

title: PostgreSQL connection pool exhausted under concurrent load
description: sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 10 overflow 10 reached, connection timed out, timeout 30.00. High concurrent API requests causing open connections to exceed max pool limit.
root_cause: Database sessions not closed in exception handlers, resulting in connection leaks under high traffic.
resolution: Wrap database operations in context managers (async with get_session()), increase pool_size to 20, max_overflow to 20, and set pool_recycle to 1800s.

title: React Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
description: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map') at UserList.render (UserList.jsx:18). Triggered when API response returns empty body before items array initializes.
root_cause: Component tries to iterate over initial state before asynchronous API fetch resolves or when payload format is unexpected.
resolution: Use optional chaining (items?.map(...)) and provide a default fallback value: (items || []).map(...), with skeleton loading states.

title: Out of Memory: Python worker killed by SIGKILL (OOMKilled)
description: Process terminated by Linux kernel OOM-killer. Worker memory exceeded container cgroup limit of 2GB during batch PDF report generation.
root_cause: Full dataset loaded into memory simultaneously instead of streaming or chunking large document batches.
resolution: Implement generator-based batch processing, invoke gc.collect() after heavy cycles, and configure celery worker_max_memory_per_child.

title: CORS policy blocked preflight OPTIONS request
description: Access to XMLHttpRequest at 'http://api.domain.com' from origin 'http://localhost:3000' has been blocked by CORS policy: Response to preflight request doesn't pass access control check: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present.
root_cause: CORSMiddleware not configured or origin domain not explicitly allowed in CORS allow_origins list.
resolution: Add CORSMiddleware in FastAPI with allow_origins=['http://localhost:3000'], allow_credentials=True, allow_methods=['*'], allow_headers=['*'].

title: IndexError: list index out of range in CSV parser
description: IndexError: list index out of range at parse_row(importer.py:87). File containing trailing empty rows or malformed delimiters crashes the pipeline.
root_cause: Direct index access row[4] without checking len(row) >= 5.
resolution: Validate row length prior to accessing column indices or use dict-based reader (csv.DictReader) with default values.

title: HTTP 502 Bad Gateway: upstream server timeout
description: Nginx 502 Bad Gateway: 110: Connection timed out while reading response header from upstream server at unix:/run/app.sock.
root_cause: Long-running report export blocking Node.js event loop causing upstream proxy timeout.
resolution: Offload long-running report calculations to background task queue and increase proxy_read_timeout in Nginx.
